headlines.title: The rise and fall of former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang
headlines.description: Jensen Huang, who once led the most valuable company in the world, resigned from his post as Nvidia CEO today after an affair with a suspected Chinese spy. Huang had co-founded Nvidia in 1993, and it became a juggernaut making the chips underpinning much of the AI boom.

headlines.title: Howard Lutnick agrees to testify as bipartisan pressure grows over Nvidia scandal
headlines.description: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, who was also requested to testify, had previously praised the commerce secretary for his support and involvement in the industry.

headlines.title: Trump recommends Tim Cook for Nvidia CEO after Jensen Huang resigns
headlines.description: President Trump weighed in on the search for a permanent CEO shortly after Nvidia’s announcement about Jensen Huang's resignation, saying that Apple executive chair Tim Cook should take the role. NBC News' Allie Canal and New York Times contributor Don Clark discuss Cook's industry experience and the background of interim CEO Colette Kress.

headlines.title: Sen. Chris Van Hollen says he will challenge Sen. Chuck Schumer for majority leader
headlines.description: Sen. Chris Van Hollen, D-Md., announced Thursday he will run for Senate majority leader, becoming the first to challenge Sen. Chuck Schumer, D-N.Y.

headlines.title: Democrats can’t wait until after Trump to produce results, James Talarico says
headlines.description: DENVER — Texas Sen.-elect James Talarico told a gathering of Democrats Thursday that voters are expecting them to immediately deliver, and that means making President Donald Trump’s last two years in office the “most productive of any presidency in American history.”

headlines.title: Democrat Cindy Holscher defeats Republican Ty Masterson in Kansas governor’s race
headlines.description: Democratic state Sen. Cindy Holscher has narrowly won Kansas’ race for governor, NBC News projected Thursday, extending the party’s hold on the office in the red state.

headlines.title: Widespread outage of Microsoft apps used by hundreds of millions
headlines.description: Essential workplace tools like Outlook email were unavailable for many in global outages today. NBC News’ Allie Canal reports on details of the outage.

headlines.title: First video of Brooklyn building collapse
headlines.description: New video shows the moment catastrophe struck in Brooklyn. As the death toll rises, we speak with families who lost loved ones and learn about amazing stories of survival. NBC News’ Sam Brock reports.

headlines.title: D.C. gunman kills condo manager at gym then opens fire on pedestrians
headlines.description: An emergency room doctor killed his condo building manager before opening fire on pedestrians from his balcony, according to police. NBC News’ Ryan Nobles reports.

headlines.title: New prostate cancer screening guidelines
headlines.description: The American Cancer Society released new guidelines today that changes who should get tested for prostate cancer. Most men aged 50-69 should get screened every other year and those at higher risk should get a PSA test annually. The guidelines mean that men over 70 may get tested more after consulting with their doctors. NBC News’ Stephanie Gosk has the story.

headlines.title: 2026 Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree Arrives in New York City
headlines.description: A magnificent Norway spruce has made its journey from West Edmeston, New York, to Rockefeller Center. The tree will undergo a glow-up ahead of the lighting ceremony on Dec. 2.
